title: Physical identification, sufficiency for all A, and leptonic cross-check for the three Wedderburn parameters
html:
Remark. Physical identification, sufficiency for all A, and leptonic cross-check for the three Wedderburn parameters

Physical identification

Parameter Irrep Observable What it fixes
\alpha_1 (3) symmetric m_\mu/m_e Substrate q_0 (all crossings +q)
\alpha_2 (2,1) standard m_e Mass scale (mixed eigenvalues)
\alpha_3 (1{,}1{,}1) alternating \mathfrak{Q}_\beta(n) Interaction scale (all crossings -q^{-1})

The symmetric sector sees only +q eigenvalues — it controls the shape of the universe (how far q is from 1). The alternating sector sees only -q^{-1} eigenvalues — it controls the interaction strength (the antisymmetric channel that drives beta decay). The standard sector mixes both eigenvalues — it controls the mass scale (the conversion between Hecke algebra units and MeV).

Sufficiency of three parameters for all A

Nuclear computations at Level 0 use H_A(R, q) (one strand per nucleon), which for A > 3 has more than three irreps. However, the typed crossing operators (typed crossing operator) C(\mathfrak{p}, \mathfrak{p}), C(\mathfrak{p}, \mathfrak{n}), C(\mathfrak{n}, \mathfrak{n}) are determined entirely by the three H_3(R, q) parameters:

  C(\mathfrak{p}, \mathfrak{p}) = \sigma \quad (d = 0),
  \qquad
  C(\mathfrak{n}, \mathfrak{n}) = \sigma - h \quad (d = -h),
  \qquad
  C(\mathfrak{p}, \mathfrak{n}) = \sigma - h/2 \quad (d = -h/2).

These three crossing types span all possible nucleon-nucleon interactions. The coefficients (0, -h, -h/2) are fixed by q alone (via h = q - q^{-1}), and the energy scale E_0 converts NF differences to MeV. No additional parameters appear at higher A because the H_A(R, q) computation factorizes through these three crossing types.

Cross-check: leptonic sector

For H_2(R, q) (two strands, leptonic physics):

  • Partitions of 2: (2) and (1{,}1)
  • H_2(R, q) \cong k \oplus k, \dim = 1^2 + 1^2 = 2
  • Two irreps \to two parameters (q_0 and m_e)
  • No standard representation \to no interaction scale needed

Leptonic physics requires only two inputs. The third input (\mathfrak{Q}_\beta) is needed only when matter and antimatter crossings coexist within a composite (hadrons).
